title: Ribbon, play, pause
idea: Richard's three levels on the ribbon: the graphite tile, Shelf's bookmark hanging from its top edge in paper, a play cut out of the ribbon, and a paper pause left standing inside the play. The ribbon runs off the tile and needs no shoulders, so it can be wider than a free-standing bookmark and give the third level more room.
built: Ribbon 46 dp wide from y 0 to tips at y 78, Shelf's notch (14.9 dp), tips r 2.03; the rounded tips reach 31.2 dp from the centre, inside the safe circle. Play 31 dp tall with its edges parallel to the notch, as in r1, corners r 2.03, placed 0.3 of the way from box to centroid centring and centred at y 45.1: walls 12.2 left, 11.5 right and 8 under. The pause is fitted by search to be as large as it can be with 2.4 dp of dark between it and the play's flat side and slanted edges: 10.2 dp tall, bars 3.3 dp, gap 2.7 dp, corners r 0.8.
small: The pause would need bars under 3 px at 48, so every cut and the glyph drop it and keep the ribbon and the play, which is still plainly the same icon. As in r1, the cuts keep a lip of tile above the ribbon (3, 2 and 1 px) so the tile stays closed on light toolbars. 48: ribbon 30 px, notch 10 px, play 20 px on column 17. 32: ribbon 20 px, notch 7 px, play 14 px on column 12. 16: ribbon 10 px, notch 4 px, play a 4 x 7 pixel staircase. Glyph: the whole bookmark, 16 px wide, with an 11 px play.
risks: Inside a ribbon the pause can only be 10 dp tall: it reads on a phone's launcher, turns to a smudge in the 1x home screen preview, and is gone from every smaller size, where this becomes r1 with a bigger play. A play with a pause inside is the media toggle, so of the three this leans furthest towards a media app, and it shares r1's Play Books risk. The play sits high, 10 to 11.5 dp below the top edge of the mask, because the notch and the safe circle take the bottom. The bleed's risks are as in r1.
